The '''Confiscation Authority''' was the governmental body that was in control of the impounds on various [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and directed by the [[Overseer of Prison Worlds]]. Each prison world had its own branch of the Confiscation Authority, which oversaw the process of impounding the goods obtained during criminal investigations and arrests at the various Confiscation Stations.
